subtitle: Thola inqwaba yemikhumbi
short_description: Thola imikhumbi efihliwe ku-chart ye-5×5 ngezinombolo zemigqa namakholomu.
description:
Thola inqwaba encane yemikhumbi ku-chart ye-5×5: umkhumbi oyodwa onamaseli amathathu ubude, omunye onamaseli amabili, nomkhumbi oyodwa onamaseli oyedwa. Imikhumbi ayikwazi ukuthintana, nangokuchezuka, futhi amanani emigqa namakholomu kumelwe afane.

Thepha isikwele ukuze umake umkhumbi, thepha futhi ukuze umake isikhumbuzo samanzi, bese uthepha okwesithathu ukuze usule. Amanani wamanje nawokufinyelela ahlala ebonakala eduze kwemigqa namakholomu ngayinye.

Amabhodi amasha ayisithupha, lilinye ngalinye livula elilandelayo lapho selixazululiwe. Ukuhlehlisa nokuqala kabusha kuhlala kutholakala, akukho sibali-sikhathi, futhi inqubekelaphambili yakho igcinwa kule divayisi. Idlala ngaphandle kwe-inthanethi. Ayikho izikhangiso, akukho i-akhawunti, akukho ukuqoqwa kwedatha.
